preconditions.description: The number of forbidden prefix products and the modulus are within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: n == 0 or (0 <= forbidden_products[i] < m for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: If there are forbidden prefix products, they are all between 0 and m - 1.

postconditions.expression: output_sequence[i] >= 0 and output_sequence[i] < m for i in range(len(output_sequence))
postconditions.description: Each element in the output sequence is an integer between 0 and m - 1, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(prefix_product(output_sequence[:i+1]) % m != forbidden_product for i in range(len(output_sequence)) for forbidden_product in forbidden_products)
postconditions.description: All prefix products of the sequence modulo m are distinct and do not appear in the list of forbidden prefix products.
The length of the sequence is maximized.
